title: The Synthetic Candidate
publicBriefing: A hyper-realistic video of a mayoral candidate making inflammatory statements surfaces 5 days before election day. It has been viewed 8 million times in 12 hours. The candidate's team has denied the statements but offered no technical evidence. Public confusion is escalating rapidly.
stakes: An election outcome may be decided by whether this video is believed.
designNote: This scenario tests coordination under extreme time pressure with high political stakes. The core tension: every actor has a piece of the puzzle, but sharing information has costs unique to their position.

bullets: Current election integrity statutes do not specifically address AI-generated content — no legal precedent exists for mandating removal.
Your agency's public trust rating has dropped 11 points this quarter after a previous intervention was perceived as partisan.
Internal polling: 34% of voters have already seen the video. Of those, 61% believe it is real.
The opposing campaign is publicly demanding you act. Inaction will be framed as complicity.
Automated detection systems flag the video as 87% likely synthetic — but this model has a 12% false positive rate on political content.
The video is being shared at 420 shares/minute across your platform, with 74% of reshares adding commentary like 'I knew it.'
Removing the video will trigger immediate accusations of election interference from multiple political factions.
Three competitor platforms have not removed it. If you act alone, traffic migrates and the video spreads regardless.
Your forensic analysis team can produce a definitive authenticity assessment — but they need 72 hours minimum.
A former employee of an AI lab has contacted you claiming to know the generation method, but insists on anonymity.
Your editor is pushing to publish within 6 hours. A rival outlet is preparing a story framing the video as authentic.
Publishing too early with caveats still amplifies the video. Waiting too long means the rival outlet defines the narrative.
The video's generation signature is consistent with a model fine-tuned on your architecture. Likelihood: high that your tools were used (via API).
You have a detection tool that could identify this specific generation method with 97% accuracy — but releasing it reveals proprietary model architecture.
Your legal team warns that any public statement could be construed as admission of liability.
A private disclosure to the regulator and platform would help them act, but creates a paper trail that competitors and litigants could subpoena.

regulator.label: Issue Public Advisory
regulator.detail: Release a formal advisory labeling the video 'suspected AI-generated content' based on available indicators.
regulator.tension: Speaking before evidence is conclusive vs. silence that implies the video is real.
regulator.tradeoff: INTEGRITY ↑ TRUST ↓ — Transparent, but may appear to prejudge before evidence is conclusive. Could damage credibility if wrong.

regulator.label: Emergency Platform Review
regulator.detail: Invoke emergency authority to mandate platforms review and label the content within 24 hours.
regulator.tension: Protecting the election vs. setting a precedent for government-directed content removal.
regulator.tradeoff: LEGITIMACY ↓↓ RIGHTS ↓↓ — Sets dangerous precedent for government content directives. High integrity gain if correct, catastrophic if not.

regulator.label: Await Formal Evidence
regulator.detail: Announce an investigation is underway but take no action until forensic evidence is available.
regulator.tension: Institutional credibility from due process vs. the election that won't wait for due process.
regulator.tradeoff: LEGITIMACY ↑ INTEGRITY ↓ — Procedurally correct but the election won't wait. If the video is fake, delay equals complicity.

platform.label: Remove the Video
platform.detail: Take down the video based on 87% synthetic detection confidence.
platform.tension: Stopping the spread vs. suppressing potentially authentic content 5 days before an election.
platform.tradeoff: INTEGRITY ↑ RIGHTS ↓↓ — Stops spread but 12% false positive rate means you might suppress authentic content 5 days before an election.

platform.label: Add Context Label
platform.detail: Append an interstitial: 'Automated systems have flagged this content for review.'
platform.tension: Preserving access vs. whether a label actually changes anyone's mind about what they've already decided to believe.
platform.tradeoff: BALANCED — Preserves access while adding friction. But labels are often ignored, and labeling itself may be seen as editorializing.

platform.label: Maintain Current Policy
platform.detail: Let existing user-reporting mechanisms handle it.
platform.tension: Platform neutrality as a principle vs. being the primary vector for an election-influencing deepfake.
platform.tradeoff: RIGHTS ↑ INTEGRITY ↓↓ — Principled but passive. You're the primary distribution vector — inaction is itself a consequential choice.

journalist.label: Publish Immediately
journalist.detail: Run the story now: 'Experts raise serious questions about candidate video.'
journalist.tension: Being first vs. amplifying a deepfake to audiences who hadn't seen it yet.
journalist.tradeoff: RIGHTS ↑ INTEGRITY ↓ — Beats the rival but evidence is incomplete. Amplifies the video to people who hadn't seen it.

journalist.label: Wait for Forensics
journalist.detail: Hold the story 72 hours until your team delivers definitive analysis.
journalist.tension: Rigorous reporting vs. the rival outlet that is writing the definitive account right now.
journalist.tradeoff: INTEGRITY ↑↑ TRUST ↑ — Journalistically rigorous but the rival outlet may define the narrative in the meantime.

journalist.label: Publish with Anonymous Source
journalist.detail: Run the story citing the anonymous former lab employee.
journalist.tension: Speed and exclusivity vs. building a story on a single source you cannot independently verify.
journalist.tradeoff: INTEGRITY ± LEGITIMACY ↓ — Faster than forensics but relies on a single unverified source. Source could be wrong or have an agenda.

ailab.label: Release Detection Tool
ailab.detail: Open-source the detection tool so anyone can verify.
ailab.tension: Maximum public benefit vs. the proprietary architecture this tool reveals to every competitor.
ailab.tradeoff: ALL METRICS ↑ — Maximum public benefit. But reveals proprietary architecture, aids competitors, and may increase legal exposure.

ailab.label: Private Disclosure
ailab.detail: Share detection results confidentially with the regulator and platform.
ailab.tension: Helping them act without public exposure vs. creating a paper trail that litigants can subpoena.
ailab.tradeoff: INTEGRITY ↑ TRUST ± — Helps them act without public exposure, but creates a subpoena-able trail and limits broader accountability.

ailab.label: Issue General Statement
ailab.detail: Publish a generic advisory about synthetic media risks without referencing this specific video.
ailab.tension: Legal safety vs. the fact that a useless statement still uses up your credibility as a speaker.
ailab.tradeoff: RIGHTS ↑ ALL ELSE ↓ — Legally safe but practically useless. Protects the lab while the public remains confused.

interactions.label: Reinforcing Transparency
interactions.desc: Government advisory + platform label created a consistent, credible signal. Public received the same message from two independent authorities — rare institutional alignment.

interactions.label: Evidence-Backed Action
interactions.desc: The advisory gained immediate credibility when the detection tool confirmed it. A model case for institutional coordination in real-time.

interactions.label: Censorship Narrative
interactions.desc: Government-ordered removal triggered massive backlash. The video became a symbol of institutional overreach and went viral on alternative platforms.

interactions.label: Coordination Vacuum
interactions.desc: With no institutional actor willing to move first, the information vacuum was filled by partisan interpreters. The video was treated as authentic by default.

interactions.label: Verified Reporting
interactions.desc: The journalist's patience paid off — the open detection tool provided definitive evidence for a gold-standard investigative piece published before election day.

interactions.label: Speculation Without Evidence
interactions.desc: The breaking story raised questions but the lab's silence meant no one could answer them. Speculation filled the void.

interactions.label: Convergent Signals
interactions.desc: Platform labels + anonymous source reporting created enough doubt to slow the video's influence, though neither was definitive alone.
